body:
Source: whole-repo bloat review (rev-trust-core finding 1 & 3). `packages/tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs` duplicates 25 functions from `packages/gate-manifest/lib/{lineage,forest,sign}.mjs`, justified by a historical fear of cycles. However, `gate-manifest` already depends on `@adlc/tickets` (importing `key-contract.mjs` and `durability.mjs`), while `tickets` has zero package dependencies. This allows consolidating all shared primitives in `@adlc/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs`, exported via `@adlc/tickets` subpath `./lib/manifest-primitives.mjs`, and having `gate-manifest` and `tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs` import them directly.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Create `packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs` containing the 25 shared primitives:
   - Path & grammar constants: `SEGMENT_DIRNAME`, `SEGMENT_NAME_RE`, `RESERVED_NAMES`, `MARKER_NAME`, `LINEAGE_NAME`, `MARKER_FORMAT`, `MARKER_VERSION`, `LOCK_SUFFIX`, `MAX_LOCAL_JSON_BYTES`, `MAX_LOCK_OWNER_BYTES`, `MAX_FIRST_LINE_BYTES`, `ULID_ALPHABET`, `OVERSIZED_FIRST_ENTRY`, `MALFORMED_FIRST_ENTRY`.
   - Filesystem & lock primitives: `segmentDirPath`, `segmentPath`, `markerPath`, `lineagePath`, `looksLikeGenuineLedgerLock`, `isSymlinkOrOtherNonRegular`, `readBoundedJsonNoFollow`, `hasActivationMarker`, `rootEndsInCutover`, `isSegmentedRepo`, `discoverSegments`.
   - ULID & slug primitives: `encodeUlidPart`, `generateSegmentUlid`, `ulidOf`, `deriveSlug`.
   - Token & discovery primitives: `currentBranch`, `readLineageToken`, `writeLineageToken`, `firstEntryOf`, `peekOpenSegment`, `recoverOpenSegment`, `assertSegmentPathCommittable`.
   - Entry signature & resolution primitives: `canonicalEntryBytes` (stripping both sig and segment on v2), `entrySigValid` (aliased as `verifyEntrySig`), `resolveOpenSegment`.
2. In `packages/tickets/package.json`:
   - Export `"./lib/manifest-primitives.mjs": "./lib/manifest-primitives.mjs"`.
3. In `packages/tickets/test/exports-map.test.mjs`:
   - Update expected exports array to include `'./lib/manifest-primitives.mjs'`.
4. In `packages/tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs`:
   - Import shared primitives from `./manifest-primitives.mjs` and re-export the public ones.
   - Delete duplicated local implementations.
   - Replace verbose review-archaeology comments on `readOwnChains` and `recoverOpenSegment` with concise contract docstrings.
5. In `packages/gate-manifest/lib/forest.mjs`:
   - Import `segmentDirPath`, `segmentPath`, `discoverSegments`, `ulidOf`, `SEGMENT_DIRNAME`, `looksLikeGenuineLedgerLock` from `@adlc/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs`.
   - Re-export the public ones and remove duplicated local implementations.
6. In `packages/gate-manifest/lib/lineage.mjs`:
   - Import and re-export `markerPath`, `lineagePath`, `readBoundedJsonNoFollow`, `isSegmentedRepo`, `generateSegmentUlid`, `deriveSlug`, `currentBranch`, `writeLineageToken`, `peekOpenSegment`, `recoverOpenSegment`, `resolveOpenSegment`, `assertSegmentPathCommittable` from `@adlc/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs`.
   - Remove duplicated local implementations.
7. In `packages/gate-manifest/lib/sign.mjs`:
   - Import and re-export `canonicalEntryBytes` from `@adlc/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs`.
8. Verify all tests pass: `npm test -w packages/tickets && npm test -w packages/gate-manifest && npm test -w packages/ticket-sync`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `packages/tickets/lib/manifest-primitives.mjs` exists and exports the shared primitives.
- AC2 `packages/tickets/package.json` exports `./lib/manifest-primitives.mjs`.
- AC3 `node --test packages/tickets/test/exports-map.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC4 `packages/gate-manifest/lib/{lineage,forest,sign}.mjs` and `packages/tickets/lib/manifest-segments.mjs` import shared primitives from manifest-primitives without duplication.
- AC5 `npm test -w packages/tickets && npm test -w packages/gate-manifest && npm test -w packages/ticket-sync` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(tickets): single-source manifest and lineage primitives between @adlc/tickets and @adlc/gate-manifest
